title: Budget Service with a Fixture-Driven Test Suite
instructions: Implement `BudgetExceeded`, `InMemoryUsageRepo` and `BudgetService` in `budget.py`. `charge` validates the token count, reads usage, rejects anything over the limit without writing, and otherwise returns the new total. Hidden pytest checks use `conftest.py` fixtures and a boundary table, so the exact error message and attributes matter.

evidence.label: Allows charges up to exactly the limit and rejects one token over
Raises ValueError("tokens must be positive") for zero and negative tokens
A rejected charge leaves usage unchanged and exposes tenant, used, requested and limit
InMemoryUsageRepo returns 0 for unknown tenants and running totals from add
remaining() reads usage through the repo
BudgetService works with any object satisfying the UsageRepo protocol
